title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje ne Misto Mame, Ne Rrugen “Thoma Koxhaj” (ID 41212082)
description_sq:
Ne Misto Mame, Ne Rrugen “Thoma Koxhaj”, Shitet Apartment 2+1, me siperfaqe totale 102 m², nga te cilat: siperfaqe neto 82 m², siperfaqe e perbashket 8 m² dhe siperfaqe e verandes 12 m².
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 6-te nje pallati te ri, me ashensor, ndertim i vitit 2012.
Organizohet ne sallon, korridor, 2 dhome gjumi, 2 tualete (njeri prej te cileve ne dhomen matrimoniale), ballkon dhe verande.
Apartamenti disponon certifikate pronesie (Me Hipoteke) dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Cmimi: 159 000 euro
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Misto Mame, on "Thoma Koxhaj" Street (ID 41212082)
description_en: In Misto Mame, on "Thoma Koxhaj" Street, Apartment 2+1 for sale, with a total area of ​​102 m², of which: net area 82 m², common area 8 m² and veranda area 12 m². The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a new building, with an elevator, built in 2012. It is organized in a living room, corridor, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (one of which is in the master bedroom), balcony and veranda. The apartment has ownership certificates (with mortgage) and is sold furnished as in the photo. Price: 159,000 euros
